### 🐛 Describe the bug

## Summary

Starting a DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model with `--mm-encoder-only` fails during model construction because `ComplexExpRotaryEmbedding` mixes a meta tensor with an NPU tensor.

The failure is deterministic on all eight TP ranks:
    
    `RuntimeError: Tensor on device meta is not on the expected device npu:0!
    `

The error happens before checkpoint loading and before the Engram embedding is initialized.

## Environment overview

  * Hardware: 8 x Ascend 910B
  * Model: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 W4A8
  * Tensor parallel size: 8
  * Quantization: `ascend`
  * Observed vLLM version: `0.31.0`
  * Mode: `--mm-encoder-only`

The complete `collect_env.py` output is provided in the environment field.

## Minimal reproduction
    
    export VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG
    export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7
    export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
    
    vllm serve \
        /path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-w4a8 \
        --mm-encoder-only \
        --tensor-parallel-size 8 \

# Qwen3-Embedding

## 1 Introduction

The Qwen3 Embedding model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B). This guide describes how to run the model with vLLM Ascend. Note that only vLLM Ascend 0.9.2rc1 and higher versions support the model.

## 2 Supported Features

Refer to Supported Features List to get the model's supported feature matrix.

This can exceed `max_num_batched_tokens`, but `AscendDSparkProposer.input_ids` is inherited with only `max_num_batched_tokens` entries.
The affected setup uses the SFA/DSpark path on current `main`, including PD serving and compiled `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` execution. The three problems below were isolated from the same A5 GLM DSpark accuracy investigation, although each is an independent runtime-correctness issue.

GLM-5.2 SFA/DSpark serving on current `main` can produce incorrect output or enter an invalid execution path because several decisions that vary by runtime batch are derived from initialization/profile state or are traced outside an opaque compiled boundary.

The investigation found three independently reproducible correctness problems.

#### 1. SFA PROLOG_V3 can incorrectly fall back to NATIVE

A KV consumer may select `PreprocessType.PROLOG_V3`, prepare its fused weights, and dispose the native projection weights during initialization. In `AscendSFAImpl.forward`, an attention state other than `DecodeOnly` or `SpecDecoding` nevertheless changes the local `fused_type` back to `NATIVE`.

This is reachable for multi-token verification/chunked-prefill and prefix-cache-hit states. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
